title: Line sketch: Misty Barn at Dawn
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A weathered gray barn with a roof stands alone in a vast, fog-shrouded field, surrounded by scattered trees under a hazy glowing sun.
